consequences: New tasks can recover current architecture, active ownership, decisions, and verification without relying on another conversation history.
Every governed change must be claimed by a workstream and completed with verification before it passes the impact gate.
Already-running tasks must rerun the status check to observe changes made after they started.
context: Codex tasks share repository files but do not share private conversation state, so project decisions and active ownership must be recoverable from versioned files.
decision: Use a curated project snapshot, independent workstream records, immutable architecture decision records, active path-overlap detection, and a CI impact gate as the authoritative cross-task coordination protocol.
title: Repository-native multi-task context governance
